title: Minority Report - Personal Advertising in the Future
summary: A one-minute clip from the film Minority Report showing digital signage that recognizes a passerby and personalizes ads to him by name. It depicts a vision of targeted advertising driven by biometric identification.
why: HN uses it as the go-to reference whenever a story involves ad tracking, facial recognition or personalized billboards.
